policy.final_label_assignment: reviewed multi-evidence decision; never top signature alone
policy.de_profile: Lodi-like RNA Wilcoxon min.pct .10, min.diff.pct .25, logfc .25; settings describe detection tests, not identity thresholds
policy.UCell: optional official implementation, complete measured signature and full source gene universe; no common acceptance cutoff
policy.origin_assignment: Context compatibility, not forced organ prediction. Collection site and primary organ remain distinct.
policy.benign_assignment: Never inferred from a normal-reference panel. Use independent CNV/genetic/pathology evidence.
policy.source27_claim: Source file contains 26 tissue rows; no invented 27th row.
